honesty: TTL is the failover floor: resume p50 ≈ TTL + detection when ownership wait is included. Raising TTL alone cuts false fences but slows every crash recovery. production_preferred is planned (not a measured result) until run at the same sample size as stock — knobs (renew every ⅕ TTL + regional lease store) are not in celld 0.4.0. ttl_only_30s is a small-n tradeoff demo (label sample size), not the preferred sole tune. Not durable execution / exactly-once.

preferredProduction.label: Preferred production (planned — not measured)
preferredProduction.leaseStore: regional-coordination (leases); program state may stay on R2
preferredProduction.expectedVsStock: Similar resume p50 to stock (same TTL); lower survivorSelfFenceRate once renew cadence / lease store land
preferredProduction.notes: Target, not a result. Do not publish as measured. Run at the same N as stock before claiming numbers. Do not ship CELLD_TTL_MS=30000 as the production answer.

rows.label: Stock — CELLD_TTL_MS=10000, leases on R2, renew ~⅓ TTL
rows.claim: Across 1000 crashes injected at every phase of a write, programs resumed on another node with no repeated writes (the 95% upper bound on the duplicate rate is 0.3%). The median resume took about 12 seconds, set by the lease timeout. Writes caught mid-flight are marked outcome unknown for a person to resolve. Under stock settings, 0.6% of surviving nodes paused themselves for safety, and 0.9% of resumes missed the recovery deadline.
rows.notes: Failover floor ≈ 10s; measured resume p50 includes ownership wait.

rows.label: TTL-only stretch — CELLD_TTL_MS=30000, same renew fraction, R2 (n=40)
rows.claim: Programs survive a node crash, resuming on another node in about 32 seconds, with no repeated writes; a write interrupted in flight is marked outcome unknown for a person to resolve.
rows.sampleSizeNote: Small sample (n=40) — label n when publishing; not comparable to stock N=1000.
rows.notes: Tradeoff demo at small sample (n=40). Expect fewer false fences, slower failover (~30s). Not the preferred sole production lever. Label n when publishing.
